messages:
raju: Heads-up: strict structured-output validation went live on the new function-route canary and the console is showing a spike in validation errors (0.7% of slice). Most failures trace to partner adapters returning unexpected arrays or nulls. We need a quick operational play.

kyra: Can you paste an example?

raju: From logs: ```json
{"fn": "lookup_items", "resp": [ {"id": "x"}, null ], "meta": {"partner": "third-co"}}
```
Our declared schema expects `resp` to be an object: `{items: [{id: int, name: string}]}`.

marta: Validator owner here. We flipped to strict reject to surface drift, but didn't realize the partner mix in this canary. Are reject events sampled or full-counted?

raju: Canary telemetry was 100% to measure impact. Ops already flagged the pager.

kyra: Ops suggestion: immediately change validator to "warn" for the canary route so requests succeed but we still capture detailed metrics. That buys time to triage.

marta: I can push that. Implementation will: 1) increment metric `fncall.schema_warns` with route and partner tags; 2) return original 200 but add header `X-Redwood-Fncall-Validation: warn`; 3) if we see a runtime parse error we still forward `tool_passthrough: true`.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: requested toggle to warn-mode by @marta. Canary-only change queued. CI quick-check passed. ETA ~9m.

raju: In parallel: we should collect redacted samples of failing payloads to s3://redwood/fncall/samples/ with partner + route metadata. Without samples triage is slow. Can we sample 1% of warn events?

marta: Yes, will add a sampling hook. We'll redact email-like tokens and 16-char hashes.

kyra: Longer term: propose a routing quarantine. Build a dynamic route table where ops can tag partner ids as `compat` and runtime will route them to `fn-compat-v1` model that accepts looser shapes. That avoids changing core validator behavior.

eva: From console-product POV: we need a dashboard tile that breaks `schema_warns` by `partner`, `route_id`, and `model_variant` and flags canary slices. Right now our graph is only model-level and hides partner skew.

raju: Agreed. Also we should avoid double-counting when backfilling telemetry. Make sure offline replay doesn't re-ingest these samples as fresh rejects.

marta: Good point. I'll add a `ingest_origin: "canary_warn"` tag on the metric and samples. That will let billing/backfill pipelines filter.

kyra: For immediate mitigation plan: (A) set warn-mode on canary (marta), (B) enable 1% sample capture (marta), (C) add dashboard split by partner (eva), (D) build a quarantine routing list and an adapter-compat shim in SDK (kyra/raju backlog).

devops-bot: deploy-bot: warn-mode toggle completed by @marta. Samples hook enabled.

raju: Initial samples show top offenders: partner ids third-co, legacy-inc, old-svc-io — I'm tagging account owners.

eva: Dashboard panel added (beta) to prod console under fncall -> validation issues. It highlights partners with >0.1% warn rate.

marta: Telemetry now: warn metric capturing but no client-facing 4xxs. Will monitor for 24h and produce a short incident note with counts and partner breakdown.

kyra: After 24h we decide: either quarantine partners to compat route or require adapter fixes. Also we should spec a permissive coercion layer for common cases (array->object, null->empty) so partners can opt-in.

raju: Thanks team. Follow-ups: eva, please make the panel persistent and add a link to samples; marta, share the postmortem + exact metric query; kyra, start a design doc for quarantine route and SDK shim. Closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
